fr:title.text: Vocal synthesis + prismatizer: findings and next steps

fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Vocal synthesis + prismatizer: findings and next steps

fr:mainmatter.html:p: Attempted to build a vocal harmonizer system for TidalCycles (prismatizer + vocal synthesis). Documenting what was built, what works, what doesn't, and the path forward.

html:ul.html:li: TTS word sample bank: lib/gen-words.sh generates per-word sample directories from a wordlist using macOS say + ffmpeg. Each word becomes its own SuperDirt sample bank (e.g. s "home love light"). Samples play at half speed in SuperDirt for unknown reasons; tts = speed 1.6 workaround in Vocab.hs.

Prismatizer effect: lib/sc/prismatizer.scd — SuperDirt per-event effect using PitchShift.ar with 3 harmony voices, per-voice detuning/vibrato, stereo spread. Registered as a SuperDirt module. Controlled via prism, prismh1-3, prismgld, prismspr params.
Formant vocal synth: lib/sc/supervocal.scd — Formant.ar-based synth with interpolatable vowel selection (vow 0-4 for a/e/i/o/u), vibrato, breathiness. Registered as \supervocal in SuperDirt.
Tidal helpers: lib/hs/Vocab.hs — param definitions, dynamics helpers (cresc, swell), pitch helpers (gliss, slurup), prismatizer presets. Loaded via :script.
Boot script: synths/boot-superdirt.scd loads custom sample banks from samples/vocab/* and loads supervocal + prismatizer on startup.

Vocal synth sounds bad. Formant.ar produces a buzzy, synthetic sound nothing like a human voice. Filtered sawtooth waves were even worse. SuperCollider's built-in synthesis primitives cannot produce convincing vocal timbre from scratch.

Prismatizer sounds robotic. PitchShift.ar is a granular pitch shifter that introduces artifacts. It lacks formant preservation — shifted voices sound chipmunked or monstrous rather than like natural singers. Not close to the Bon Iver / Imogen Heap / Francis and the Lights sound.

TTS samples play at half speed. Samples generated by macOS say play at approximately half the expected speed in SuperDirt. The bd sample from SuperDirt's own library plays correctly when placed in the same custom bank. Root cause unknown — not a sample rate issue, not a WAV header issue, not a format issue.

fr:mainmatter.html:p: The Bon Iver vocal harmonizer sound requires real vocal input, not synthesis. Three viable directions:

html:ol.html:li: Recorded vocal samples: Record sustained vowel notes at different pitches, use as sample banks. Loop with SuperDirt's loopAt/legato. Apply prismatizer for harmonies.
Live mic input: Route microphone through SuperCollider, apply prismatizer in real-time. This is literally what Bon Iver does live.
Better pitch shifting: Replace PitchShift.ar with a formant-preserving approach — e.g. analysis/resynthesis via FFT, or use an external VST plugin via SuperCollider's VSTPlugin quark.
